lines.zh: 我踩着空气，一步一步升高。
lines.en: I tread the air, rising step by step.

lines.zh: 龙身一摆，我沿着天边滑行。
lines.en: One sway of my dragon body and I glide along the horizon.
I land and my four claws crack the ground.
I circle the field slowly.

lines.zh: 这具蛇形身子，转向不易。
lines.en: This serpentine body doesn't turn easily.
The ki of five Dragon Balls is gathered.
I float without touching ground.
I spiral down along the tower top.
The wind loses its direction in my wake.
I lift a foreclaw and step out slowly.
I pass through cloud and look down.

lines.zh: 这一片地方，我先走一遍。
lines.en: I'll walk this area first.
I coil and hang in the air.
Light flows across my scales.
Steam rises from between my scales.
I circled three times above the clouds.
The air here is too close.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴绕了一圈，收好。
lines.en: I coil my tail once and settle it.
The five-star dragon's shadow circles you.

lines.zh: 高处看得远，我不急下去。
lines.en: From up high I see far; I won't descend yet.
Holding this power in is uncomfortable.

lines.zh: 我静静听着下面的动静。
lines.en: I listen quietly to the movement below.

lines.zh: 风经过我的角，发出低响。
lines.en: The wind passes my horns with a low sound.

lines.zh: 我盘在塔尖上，像一尊雕。
lines.en: I coil on the spire like a statue.
I coil on the tower top to rest my wings.
Let them search first.

lines.zh: 这么小的东西，抬头看我。
lines.en: Such a small thing, looking up at me.
I lower my head close to you.

lines.zh: 你在我眼里，只有一点点。
lines.en: In my eyes, you are only a speck.
I know this kind of aura.
I roll my eye to look behind you.
Your hand is hunting for a weapon, isn't it?

lines.zh: 我不需要动手，你就退了。
lines.en: I needn't move and you already retreat.

lines.zh: 我的影子盖住半个场地。
lines.en: My shadow covers half the field.
Staring at me like that is rude.

lines.zh: 我嗅了嗅空气，你的味道很淡。
lines.en: I sniff the air; your scent is faint.
That you stand your ground is rare.
My fangs simply showed for a moment.
I blink slowly; you're still there.
This small, and you still came?

lines.zh: 我盘起来，让你看清全貌。
lines.en: I coil up so you see me whole.

lines.zh: 你抬头看我的时候屏气了。
lines.en: You held your breath when you looked up.
Don't let your mind wander; I'm right here.
I'm beginning to find this interesting.
You dare touch my scales?
One hit, and I'm not down.
My body is long; dodging is slow.
The pain sharpens me.
I back half a coil and settle again.
A few scales came loose.
You think this can wound me?
One of my whiskers is snapped.
My flight banked off course a little.

lines.zh: 五星龙的鳞，被砍开了口子。
lines.en: A gash has been cut in the five-star dragon's scales.
You'd lure me with this?
I sniff it; not very interested.
If you truly offer it, I'll take it.
I lower my dragon head toward it.
This won't fill the gaps in my teeth.

lines.zh: 我很久没吃人给的东西。
lines.en: I haven't eaten what humans offer in ages.
Not bad; you had some thought.

lines.zh: 我伸出爪子，轻轻拨了拨。
lines.en: I reach out a claw and nudge it.
Keep your hand steady; I won't bite you.
Very well, I'll accept this.
You hit me and stagger back three steps.

lines.zh: 我的身子像一堵会动的墙。
lines.en: My body is a moving wall.

lines.zh: 别贴着我，鳞片会划伤人。
lines.en: Don't press against me; scales cut.
I turn and you're pushed aside.
I leave a ring of marks on the ground.
My tail sweeps across the rooftop.
My tail sweeps past and you back away.
Touching me comes at a price.

lines.zh: 我停着不动，你也过不去。
lines.en: I stay still, and you still can't pass.
Sparks scrape off my scales.

lines.zh: 另一条龙从云里出来了。
lines.en: Another dragon comes out of the cloud.
Our scale-light mingles.

lines.zh: 两条长身子绕着同一根柱子。
lines.en: Two long bodies coil the same pillar.
I call low and she answers.
This sky is wide enough for both of us.
We fly past the tower top side by side.
Between dragons, few words are needed.
She coils on the spire beside mine.
The wind is strong; we stay close.
Tonight there are no clouds in the sky.
I pinch it up in a claw.
This is interesting; I'll keep it.
I dip down and carry it off.
Whatever falls to the ground is mine.
I set it on the spire to air.
So small I nearly missed it.
I turn it over and around.
Keep it; it may be of use.
I nudge it over with a foreclaw.
This find counts for little.
It's you; no need to choose further.
I've chosen you; stay still.
I sink my ki down into my claws.
I gather energy at my claw tips.
I have your position fixed.
Once locked, it doesn't change.
Coming from above is convenient.

lines.zh: 我是五星龙，气功激光先到。
lines.en: I'm Wu Xing Long; my beam arrives first.
Good; I needed an opponent.
I raise my head and draw breath.
This will not be light.
You do have some nerve.
A starlight glows on my forehead.
I don't shout; I simply descend.
Good, I begin.
You can't back out of this.
I slowly lose altitude.

lines.zh: 五星的光，一直落在你背后。
lines.en: The five-star glow keeps falling behind you.
I judge where your next step goes.
Energy forms between my claws.
I fold my wings and ready a dive.
This distance suits me.

lines.zh: 我绕着龙柱转了一圈，五星都亮了。
lines.en: I circled the dragon pillar; all five stars lit.

lines.zh: 你的气乱了，快撑不住了。
lines.en: Your aura is ragged; you won't last.
No hurry; a dragon has time.
There is no cover below.
I raise a foreclaw, gathering force.
A little closer and I strike.
I lower my head and take aim.

lines.zh: 五星的光，从背上压下来。
lines.en: Five-star light bears down from my back.
I've waited long for this blow.
The wind blows from my side.

lines.zh: 我的气在喉咙里聚起来。
lines.en: My ki gathers in my throat.

lines.zh: 龙身一摆，星珠在胸口亮起。
lines.en: My dragon body twists, the star pearl glowing at my chest.
One claw strike and the ground breaks.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴横扫，把你掀翻。
lines.en: My tail sweeps you off your feet.
I pounce from above and pin you.
I swipe a claw at your chest.
The ki blast grazes your shoulder.
I bite down; my teeth are sharp.
My claw grips you and presses down.

lines.zh: 你挡得住一下，挡不住连击。
lines.en: You stop one blow, not the string.
Light pours from my mouth.
I put extra force into this one.
The dust shakes into a fog.
You're at the wall with no way left.

lines.zh: 我的动作不算快，但很重。
lines.en: I'm not fast, but I'm heavy.

lines.zh: 这一击落下，场地都静了。
lines.en: The blow lands and the field goes quiet.

lines.zh: 我落下时，气浪把地面压平。
lines.en: As I land, the shockwave flattens the ground.
This claw cuts in from your flank.
I emerge from the cloud layer.
The sky darkens; I have arrived.
Wu Xing Long appears.
This sky is mine to circle now.
I coil on the spire and look down.
Scale-light falls from above.

lines.zh: 我一个俯冲，落在场地中央。
lines.en: One dive and I land in the center.
The wind arrives first; I follow.

lines.zh: 这具身子很长，你抬头看全了吗？
lines.en: This body is long; did you see all of it?
Whoever summoned me, stand back.
I wrap my tail around the pillar.
The clouds parted because I'm here.

lines.zh: 我落到地上，四爪陷进土里。
lines.en: I land and my claws sink into soil.
From now on, don't look up.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地盘起来，先看清局势。
lines.en: I coil slowly and read the situation.
The dragon is here, and the wind has changed.
This match deserves my full attention.
I greet you with a low call.

lines.zh: 火在我鳞上流，像被热水浇。
lines.en: Fire runs over my scales like hot water.

lines.zh: 我从云里坠下来，砸出一个坑。
lines.en: I fall from the clouds and leave a crater.

lines.zh: 水压着我的气，我憋得难受。
lines.en: Water presses on my energy; I can't breathe.

lines.zh: 爆光挑开我的鳞，热气直灌。
lines.en: Blast light pries my scales apart and heat pours in.
An arrow lodges in my dragon neck.

lines.zh: 这股咒力绕着我的龙骨转。
lines.en: This magic winds around my bones.
Too hungry to gather my energy.

lines.zh: 雷劈在我的角上，一路麻到尾巴。
lines.en: Lightning hits my horns and numbs me to the tail.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有风，我盘不住。
lines.en: No wind in the void; I can't hold my coil.
